title: In-vivo and Ex-vivo Tissue Characterization
summary: Building a database of in-vivo human tissue properties for the next generation of surgical simulators.
body: Accurate properties of living biological tissues are critically important to the advancement of medical simulation science. Two gaps stood in the way: there was no sufficient database of human tissue properties for surgical simulators to draw on, and there were few robotic tools able to measure in-vivo tissue characteristics in the first place.

This project built both. A further thread examined how tissue properties shift between the living and ex-vivo states — accounting for perfusion, temperature, and related factors — so that the large body of existing ex-vivo data could be made useful for simulator development.
